correctness.rationale: For nearest-neighbor symmetric walk with observations S0…Sn sorted with ties, minimum multiplicity R_n yields states (0,0),(0,1),(1,1) except the unique-next-level endpoint event (1,2). Decomposing at min visits yields formal generating functions A(z)^2 E(z)^(r−1), A=(1+(1+z)/sqrt(1−z²))/2, E=(1−sqrt(1−z²))/2; R=2 has mass 1/4. Unique minimum and adjacent level at an endpoint has c_n=binom(n−2,floor((n−2)/2))/2^(n−1), so the four exact joint masses follow. Their TV distance to (1/4,1/4,1/2,0) is exactly c_n. Independently enumerated all 8188 paths over 2≤n≤12 with exact rational matches. Proof is the generating-function argument for all n≥2, not enumeration.
